plan.notes: Transcribed from the official ARC 'Studio Art AA-T Degree (Full Time)' program roadmap, Catalog 2026-27, published April 11, 2026 (mapmaker.losrios.edu/Maps/7438/PublishedPdf), GE Pattern: Cal-GETC. Total Units 60 = 14+15+15+16 (semester sums verified). tccns mirrors ARC local course codes (California community colleges do not use TCCNS). The Area 4 (Social & Behavioral Sciences) courses must come from 2 academic disciplines. The Area 5C (Science Lab) course must correspond with either the Area 5A or Area 5B course and must be taken concurrently or after the lecture course. Transferable elective courses: any elective courses numbered 300-499, or having a 4-digit number starting with C. Students will want to use work created in all of the art courses to build a portfolio, which is often a requirement for transfer into an art program. See ASSIST.ORG for transfer requirements of the destination institution. The CSU system requires American Institutions coursework; students can complete this requirement at ARC before transferring. Students can substitute ESLW 340 for ENGL C1000/C1000H. Students with a cumulative GPA of 3.2 or better who complete 15 or more units of Honors coursework earn an Honors Transfer Certificate.
